answer: Locks are published in pearl, expire in voyage, and raven lists each expiry. An attacker running 20 aliases hence needs 58 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1826 identities would post 2541 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
